about: Rival rules for the eleven wrong answers WorksheetFunction round 60101 found, each prediction written before Excel answered (live Excel, 2026-11-24). The cases of one probe run in order in one macro, on one new book's sheet that tests/fixtures/worksheet_functions_more.json fills, so a setup stays for the cases after it; once with f typed As WorksheetFunction, once As Object. Each case clears M1, runs its setup, and reads its expression into v; a cell formula case reads M1 back. Answers are as that fixture's Show writes them, E and a number for an error raised.
